220	class ClaudeSessions:
221	    def __init__(self, directory: Path, executable: str = "claude", timeout: float = 1800):
222	        self.directory = directory.resolve()
223	        self.plan = read_json(self.directory / "plan.json")
224	        self.workers = plan_workers(self.plan)
225	        self.excluded = plan_excluded(self.plan)
226	        if set(self.plan["nodes"]) != set(self.workers):
227	            raise RuntimeError("Run preparation is incomplete; inspect retained allocation state")
228	        for node in self.workers:
229	            info = self.plan["nodes"][node]
230	            if Path(info["worktree"]).resolve() != self.directory / f"worktree-{node}" or info["observed_start_commit"] != self.plan["base_commit"]:
231	                raise RuntimeError("Invalid worktree identity/start revision in plan")
232	        self.executable = executable
233	        self.timeout = timeout
234	        self.cancelled = threading.Event()
235	
236	    def run(self, node: str) -> dict:
237	        if node not in self.workers:
238	            raise ValueError("Unknown worker")
239	        if self.cancelled.is_set():
240	            raise RuntimeError("Controller cancelled before launch")
241	        info = self.plan["nodes"][node]
242	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.json"
243	        digest = plan_digest(self.plan)
244	        if path.exists():
245	            previous = read_json(path)
246	            if previous["plan_digest"] != digest:
247	                raise RuntimeError("Run plan changed; refuse result reuse/relaunch")
248	            if previous["status"] == "succeeded":
249	                return previous
250	            raise RuntimeError(f"{node}: existing {previous['status']} session {previous['session_id']}; reconcile before any relaunch")
251	        cwd = Path(info["worktree"])
252	        record = {"node_id": node, "session_id": info["session_id"], "attempt": 1,
253	                  "status": "launching", "pid": None, "plan_digest": digest,
254	                  "worktree": str(cwd), "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"]}
255	        save_json(path, record)  # A crash from here onward must never cause blind relaunch.
256	        tools = "Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write" if self.plan["allow_edits"] else "Read,Glob,Grep"
257	        command = [self.executable, "--print", "--verbose", "--output-format", "stream-json",
258	                   "--session-id", info["session_id"], "--safe-mode", "--strict-mcp-config",
259	                   "--mcp-config", '{"mcpServers":{}}', "--tools", tools,
260	                   "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits" if self.plan["allow_edits"] else "dontAsk",
261	                   "--permission-prompts", "none"]
262	        prompt = ("You are an independent workflow worker. Do not launch other agents, modify shared contract files, "
263	                  "commit, merge, push or change files outside your assigned worktree. "
264	                  "Report changed files, checks actually executed, and open assumptions. "
265	                  "No command execution tools are enabled in this initial session slice.\n\n" + info["task"])
266	        # Do not let detached workers target the controller's Herdr pane through hooks.
267	        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("HERDR_")}
268	        env["TMPDIR"] = str(self.directory / f"tmp-{node}")
269	        Path(env["TMPDIR"]).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
270	        process = None
271	        try:
272	            if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"] or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"):
273	                raise RuntimeError(f"{node}: worktree changed since preparation")
274	            prompt_path = self.directory / f"{node}.prompt.txt"
275	            prompt_path.write_text(prompt)
276	            os.chmod(prompt_path, 0o600)
277	            # A regular stdin file avoids blocking the controller on a full pipe.
278	            with prompt_path.open("rb") as input_handle, (self.directory / f"{node}.stream.jsonl").open("wb") as output:
279	                process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=input_handle,
280	                                           stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
281	                record.update(status="running", pid=process.pid)
282	                save_json(path, record)
283	                import time
284	                deadline = time.monotonic() + self.timeout
285	                while process.poll() is None:
286	                    if self.cancelled.wait(0.1) or time.monotonic() > deadline:
287	                        terminate(process)
288	                        raise RuntimeError("Controller cancelled or session timed out; partial work preserved")
289	                output.flush()
290	                os.fsync(output.fileno())
291	            terminal = None
292	            with (self.directory / f"{node}.stream.jsonl").open(errors="replace") as output:
293	                for line in output:
294	                    try:
295	                        message = json.loads(line)
296	                    except ValueError:
297	                        continue
298	                    if isinstance(message, dict) and message.get("type") == "result":
299	                        terminal = message
300	            record["exit_code"] = process.returncode
301	            if not terminal or terminal.get("session_id") != info["session_id"]:
302	                raise RuntimeError("Missing or mismatched Claude terminal result; reconciliation required")
303	            record["claude_result"] = terminal
304	            if process.returncode != 0 or terminal.get("is_error") is not False or terminal.get("subtype") != "success":
305	                raise RuntimeError("Claude did not succeed; inspect retained result for usage, permission or execution failure. No automatic retry/provider switch.")
306	            record["status"] = "succeeded"
307	        except BaseException as error:
308	            if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
309	                terminate(process)
310	            record.update(status="blocked", error=str(error))
311	            raise
312	        finally:
313	            # Preserve work and a diff even after failure; untracked files remain in the worktree.
314	            try:
315	                record["git_status"] = git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain")
316	                with (self.directory / f"{node}.patch").open("w") as patch:
317	                    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "diff", "--binary", self.plan["base_commit"]], stdout=patch, check=True)
318	            except Exception as error:
319	                record["evidence_error"] = str(error)
320	                record["status"] = "blocked"
321	            save_json(path, record)
322	        if record["status"] != "succeeded":
323	            raise RuntimeError("Session evidence capture failed")
324	        return record

108	def check_reviewers(entries, worker_ids: set, declared: list[str] | None, verdict: str, require_approved: bool) -> list[str]:
109	    """The combined record's `reviewers` list: declared order, distinct independent identities, unanimous approval when approved."""
110	    if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
111	        raise ValueError("Review reviewers must be a non-empty list")
112	    ids, sessions = [], []
113	    for entry in entries:
114	        if (not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != REVIEWER_ENTRY_KEYS or not isinstance(entry["reviewer_id"], str) or not entry["reviewer_id"].strip()
115	                or entry["verdict"] not in {"approved", "blocked", None} or (entry["accepted_at"] is not None and not isinstance(entry["accepted_at"], str))):
116	            raise ValueError("Malformed review reviewers entry")
117	        session = entry["session_id"]
118	        if session is not None and (not isinstance(session, str) or not session.strip() or session in worker_ids or session in sessions):
119	            raise ValueError(f"Independent reviewer identity required for reviewer {entry['reviewer_id']}")
120	        if session is not None:
121	            sessions.append(session)
122	        ids.append(entry["reviewer_id"])
123	    if len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
124	        raise ValueError("Review reviewers must be distinct")
125	    if declared is not None and ids != list(declared):
126	        raise ValueError(f"Review reviewers ({', '.join(ids)}) are not this run's declared reviewers ({', '.join(declared)})")
127	    if verdict == "approved" and any(entry["verdict"] != "approved" for entry in entries):
128	        raise ValueError("An approved review requires every reviewer's approval")
129	    if require_approved and any(entry["verdict"] != "approved" for entry in entries):
130	        raise ValueError("Review is not approved by every reviewer")

134	def check_review(review: dict, bundle: dict, digest: str, *, require_approved: bool = True, allow_legacy: bool = False,
135	                 reviewers: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
136	    """Shape and identity of a persisted review against its exact bundle; approval is checked only when required.
137	
138	    `allow_legacy` accepts the two-lane `both` attribution of reviews recorded before configured lanes (export only).
139	    `reviewers` is the run's declared reviewer list: the record must then list exactly those reviewers and tag every
140	    finding with one of them. Without it (export), a record without `reviewers` is the single-reviewer shape.
141	    """
142	    if (not isinstance(review, dict) or not REVIEW_KEYS <= set(review) <= REVIEW_KEYS | {"reviewers"} or review["run_id"] != bundle["run_id"]
143	            or review["bundle_sha256"] != digest or review["candidate_commit"] != bundle["candidate_commit"]):
144	        raise ValueError("Review must reference this exact run, bundle hash and candidate")
145	    worker_ids = {item["session_id"] for item in bundle["snapshots"].values()}
146	    if review["independent"] is not True or not isinstance(review["reviewer"], str) or not review["reviewer"].strip() or review["reviewer"] in worker_ids:
147	        raise ValueError("Independent reviewer identity required")
148	    if review["verdict"] not in {"approved", "blocked"} or not isinstance(review["findings"], list):
149	        raise ValueError("Malformed review verdict or findings")
150	    if require_approved and review["verdict"] != "approved":
151	        raise ValueError("Review is not approved")
152	    ids = None
153	    if "reviewers" in review:
154	        ids = check_reviewers(review["reviewers"], worker_ids, reviewers, review["verdict"], require_approved)
155	    elif reviewers is not None and list(reviewers) != [DEFAULT_REVIEWER]:
156	        raise ValueError(f"Review lacks the reviewers list this run requires ({', '.join(reviewers)})")
157	    # The bundle's snapshots are exactly the run's selected lanes.
158	    workers = set(bundle["snapshots"]) | (LEGACY_FINDING_ATTRIBUTIONS if allow_legacy else FINDING_ATTRIBUTIONS)
159	    for finding in review["findings"]:
160	        if (not isinstance(finding, dict) or not FINDING_KEYS <= set(finding) <= FINDING_KEYS | FINDING_LINK_KEYS
161	                or finding["severity"] not in {"P0", "P1", "P2"} or finding["disposition"] not in {"open", "resolved", "accepted"}
162	                or not isinstance(finding["message"], str) or not finding["message"].strip()):
163	            raise ValueError("Malformed review finding")
164	        if "worker" in finding and finding["worker"] not in workers:
165	            raise ValueError(f"Malformed review finding worker: expected one of {', '.join(sorted(workers))}, got {finding['worker']!r}")
166	        requirement = finding.get("requirement")
167	        if requirement is not None and (not isinstance(requirement, str) or not requirement.strip()):
168	            raise ValueError("Malformed review finding requirement")
169	        if ids is not None:
170	            if finding.get("reviewer") not in ids:
171	                raise ValueError(f"Review finding names reviewer {finding.get('reviewer')!r}; expected one of {', '.join(ids)}")
172	        elif "reviewer" in finding and (not isinstance(finding["reviewer"], str) or not finding["reviewer"].strip()):
173	            raise ValueError("Malformed review finding reviewer")
174	        if review["verdict"] == "approved" and blocking_findings([finding]):
175	            raise ValueError("Unresolved blocking review finding")

233	def lane_positions(workers: list[str]) -> tuple[dict, list, int, int]:
234	    """Report layout: one row per lane for the fan-outs, the fixed tail centred on them."""
235	    rows = [70 + 140 * index for index in range(len(workers))]
236	    centre = (rows[0] + rows[-1]) // 2
237	    positions = {}
238	    for node, y in zip(workers, rows):
239	        positions[f"launch_{node}"] = (90, y)
240	    positions["handoff"] = (280, centre)
241	    for node, y in zip(workers, rows):
242	        positions[f"verify_{node}"] = (470, y)
243	    positions.update(candidate=(660, centre), review=(850, centre), approval=(1040, centre), integrate=(1230, centre))
244	    edges = [(f"launch_{node}", "handoff") for node in workers] + [("handoff", f"verify_{node}") for node in workers] \
245	        + [(f"verify_{node}", "candidate") for node in workers] + [("candidate", "review"), ("review", "approval"), ("approval", "integrate")]
246	    return positions, edges, 1330, rows[-1] + 70

328	    def stop_session(self, node: str) -> None:
329	        """Persist native identity before stopping. Never signal guessed/reused PIDs."""
330	        marker = self.directory / f"{node}.stop.json"
331	        if marker.exists():

334	            row = self.sessions.locate(node, self.sessions.inventory())
335	            if row is None:

337	            intent = {"background_id": row["id"], "session_id": row["sessionId"], "pid": row["pid"], "stopped": False}
338	            save_json(marker, intent)

341	            matching = [row for row in rows if row.get("sessionId") == intent["session_id"] and row.get("pid")]
342	            if matching:

344	                if row is None or row["id"] != intent["background_id"] or row["pid"] != intent["pid"]:

346	                result = subprocess.run([self.sessions.executable, "stop", intent["background_id"]], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)

350	            rows = self.sessions.inventory()
351	            if any(row.get("sessionId") == intent["session_id"] and row.get("pid") for row in rows) or pid_alive(intent["pid"]):

368	    def freeze(self) -> dict:
369	        record = self.directory / "snapshots.json"
370	        if record.exists():
371	            return read_json(record)
372	        handoffs = {}
373	        for node in self.workers:
374	            handoff_path = self.directory / f"{node}.handoff.json"
375	            if not handoff_path.exists():
376	                raise ValueError(f"Missing {node} handoff: summary and open_assumptions are required")
377	            handoff = read_json(handoff_path)
378	            if set(handoff) != {"summary", "open_assumptions"} or not isinstance(handoff["summary"], str) or not handoff["summary"].strip() or not isinstance(handoff["open_assumptions"], list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in handoff["open_assumptions"]):
379	                raise ValueError("Malformed worker handoff")
380	            handoffs[node] = handoff
381	        self.stop_workers()
382	        # Ownership is enforced from the full declared policy: an excluded lane's paths are off-limits to every selected lane.
383	        excluded_paths = [(other, safe_path(prefix)) for other in self.excluded for prefix in self.worker_policy(other)["owned_paths"]]
384	        snapshots = {}
385	        for node in self.workers:
386	            worker = self.worker_policy(node)
387	            cwd = Path(self.plan["nodes"][node]["worktree"])
388	            if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"]:
389	                raise ValueError("Worker changed HEAD; reconcile commits rather than silently accepting them")
390	            changed = changed_files(cwd, self.plan["base_commit"])
391	            for name in changed:
392	                safe_path(name)
393	                for other, prefix in excluded_paths:
394	                    if owns(name, prefix):
395	                        raise ValueError(f"Ownership violation: {node} edited {name}, owned by excluded lane {other}")
396	                if not any(owns(name, safe_path(prefix)) for prefix in worker["owned_paths"]):
397	                    raise ValueError(f"{node} edited unowned path: {name}")
398	                if (cwd / name).is_symlink():
399	                    raise ValueError("Symlink changes require manual review before snapshot")
400	            index = self.directory / f"{node}.snapshot-index"
401	            if index.exists():
402	                index.unlink()  # Only our private temporary index, never a user's index.
403	            env = commit_env()
404	            env["GIT_INDEX_FILE"] = str(index)
405	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "read-tree", self.plan["base_commit"]], env=env, check=True)
406	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "add", "-A", "--", "."], env=env, check=True)
407	            tree = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "write-tree"], env=env, text=True).strip()
408	            # Validate paths from the actual captured tree, including staged renames/deletes.
409	            captured = git(cwd, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--no-renames", "--name-only", "-r", self.plan["base_commit"], tree).splitlines()
410	            if sorted(captured) != changed:
411	                raise ValueError("Files changed during snapshot; refuse inconsistent evidence")
412	            commit = self.plan["base_commit"]
413	            if changed:
414	                commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "commit-tree", tree,
415	                                                  "-p", self.plan["base_commit"], "-m", f"Workflow {self.plan['run_id']}: {node}"], env=env, text=True).strip()
416	            ref = f"refs/workflow/{hashlib.sha256(str(self.directory).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]}/{node}"
417	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "update-ref", ref, commit], check=True)
418	            receipt = read_json(self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")
419	            snapshots[node] = {"commit": commit, "changed_files": changed, "session_id": receipt["session_id"], **handoffs[node]}
420	        save_json(record, snapshots)
421	        self.event("freeze", "succeeded", "Immutable snapshots captured; worker-reported checks are not trusted")
422	        return snapshots

493	            candidate = {"commit": git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD"), "worktree": str(cwd)}

531	            if not packet_path.is_relative_to(self.directory) or digest_file(packet_path) != reference["sha256"]:

546	        self.validate_review(review)

569	class ExportRuntime:
570	    """Read-only view of a run directory for re-exporting run-state.json.
571	
572	    It constructs no sessions and touches no worktree, so a copied or finished
573	    run whose worktrees are gone still exports. Contradictory files are refused.
574	    """
575	
576	    def __init__(self, directory: Path):
577	        self.directory = directory.resolve()
578	        self.plan = read_json(self.directory / "plan.json")
579	        if "automatic" in self.plan:
580	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
581	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
582	        self.policy = None
583	        policy_path = self.directory / "policy.json"
584	        if policy_path.exists():
585	            self.policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(policy_path))
586	            if self.plan.get("policy_sha256") != policy_digest(self.policy):
587	                raise ValueError("Pinned policy changed")
588	        self.workers, self.excluded = lanes_of(self.plan, self.policy)
589	        review_path = self.directory / "review.json"
590	        if review_path.exists():
591	            bundle_path = self.directory / "review-bundle.json"
592	            if not bundle_path.exists():
593	                raise ValueError("review.json exists without review-bundle.json; contradictory run directory")
594	            # Packet hashes are not rechecked here; the adapter re-verifies packets itself. Reviews recorded
595	            # before configured lanes may attribute a finding to `both`; the viewer renders it as several lanes.
596	            check_review(read_json(review_path), read_json(bundle_path), digest_file(bundle_path), require_approved=False,
597	                         allow_legacy="workers" not in self.plan)

600	def lanes_of(plan: dict, policy: dict | None) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
601	    """The run's selected and excluded lanes, checked against the pinned policy when it is present."""
602	    workers, excluded = plan_workers(plan), plan_excluded(plan)
603	    if policy is not None:
604	        declared = policy_workers(policy)
605	        if not set(workers) <= set(declared) or not set(excluded) <= set(declared):
606	            raise ValueError("Plan names lanes the pinned policy does not declare")
607	        if "workers" in plan and set(workers) | set(excluded) != set(declared):
608	            raise ValueError("Plan does not account for every declared lane")
609	    if set(plan.get("nodes", {})) != set(workers):
610	        raise ValueError("Plan nodes do not match the selected lanes; inspect retained allocation state")
611	    return workers, excluded

614	def carry_legacy_lanes(runtime: ExportRuntime, state, saver: SqliteSaver | None = None):
615	    """Carry a pre-lane checkpoint's per-lane evidence into the lane state shape.
616	
617	    A checkpoint written before configured lanes stored each lane under `<lane>` and
618	    `<lane>_packet`; the graph no longer has those channels, so `get_state` drops them.
619	    Read them from the raw checkpoint and carry them under `lanes`/`packets` so the launch
620	    evidence survives every export, whether from `export` or from the report written at
621	    each CLI boundary. Runs with configured lanes are returned unchanged.
622	    """
623	    from types import SimpleNamespace
624	    database = runtime.directory / "pipeline.sqlite"
625	    if "workers" in runtime.plan or not database.exists():
626	        return state
627	    config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": runtime.plan["run_id"]}}

659	def build_pipeline(checkpointer, runtime):
660	    """The graph over the runtime's plan: `launch_<lane>` and `verify_<lane>` per selected lane, then the fixed tail."""
661	    workers = list(runtime.workers)
662	    def launcher(node):
663	        return lambda _state: {"lanes": {node: runtime.launch(node)}}
664	    def verifier(node):
665	        return lambda state: {"packets": {node: runtime.verify(node, state["snapshots"])}}
666	    def handoff(_state):
667	        message = ("Awaiting explicit completion signals and automatic freeze." if runtime.plan.get("automatic")
668	                   else f"Type in Claude terminals; provide a handoff for every lane ({', '.join(workers)}), then explicitly freeze.")
669	        decision = interrupt({"kind": "worker_handoff", "message": message})
670	        if decision != {"freeze": True}:
671	            raise ValueError("Explicit freeze required")
672	        return {"snapshots": runtime.freeze()}
673	    def candidate(state): return {"bundle": runtime.candidate(state)}
674	    def review(_state):
675	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
676	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
677	            from .automatic import review_candidate
678	            decision = review_candidate(runtime)
679	        else:
680	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "independent_review", "bundle_sha256": digest,
681	                                  "bundle_path": str(runtime.directory / "review-bundle.json")})
682	        runtime.validate_review(decision)
683	        save_json(runtime.directory / "review.json", decision)
684	        runtime.event("review", "approved", decision["reviewer"])
685	        return {"review": decision}
686	    def approval(_state):
687	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
688	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
689	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
690	            validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
691	            decision = {"approve": digest}  # Explicit run-level authority: feature branch only.
692	        else:
693	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "integration_approval", "bundle_sha256": digest,
694	                                  "message": "Approve fast-forward of source branch; no push."})
695	        if decision != {"approve": digest}:
696	            raise ValueError("Explicit exact-bundle approval required")
697	        return {"approved_bundle": digest}
698	    def integrate(state): return {"integrated_commit": runtime.integrate(state["approved_bundle"])}
699	    graph = StateGraph(PipelineState)
700	    launches = [f"launch_{node}" for node in workers]
701	    verifies = [f"verify_{node}" for node in workers]
702	    for node, name in zip(workers, launches):
703	        graph.add_node(name, launcher(node))
704	    for node, name in zip(workers, verifies):
705	        graph.add_node(name, verifier(node))
706	    for name, function in (("handoff", handoff), ("candidate", candidate), ("review", review), ("approval", approval), ("integrate", integrate)):
707	        graph.add_node(name, function)
708	    for name in launches:
709	        graph.add_edge(START, name)
710	    graph.add_edge(launches, "handoff")
711	    for name in verifies:
712	        graph.add_edge("handoff", name)
713	    graph.add_edge(verifies, "candidate")
714	    graph.add_edge("candidate", "review"); graph.add_edge("review", "approval")
715	    graph.add_edge("approval", "integrate"); graph.add_edge("integrate", END)
716	    return graph.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)

742	def report(runtime: Pipeline, state) -> Path:
743	    """Escaped local results viewer, generated on every CLI boundary; no server needed."""
744	    state = carry_legacy_lanes(runtime, state)  # `status` on a legacy run must export the same evidence as `export`.
745	    export_state(runtime, state)
746	    events_path = runtime.directory / "events.jsonl"
747	    events = [json.loads(line) for line in events_path.read_text().splitlines()] if events_path.exists() else []
748	    packets = list((runtime.directory / "verification").glob("*/*/*/packet.json"))
749	    flow = ("Launch workers → completion signals → isolated checks → combined checks → independent review → verified feature branch (no main merge or push)"
750	            if runtime.plan.get("automatic") else "Launch workers → human handoff → isolated checks → combined checks → independent review → approval → integration")
751	    parts = ['<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Workflow report</title><style>body{font:16px system-ui;max-width:1100px;margin:40px auto;background:#151820;color:#eee}pre{white-space:pre-wrap}a{color:#8dcaff}img{max-width:100%}section{border:1px solid #555;padding:16px;margin:16px 0}</style>',
752	             '<h1>Workflow report</h1><p>' + html.escape(flow) + '</p>',
753	             '<h2>Current state</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps({"next": state.next, "interrupts": [str(task.interrupts) for task in state.tasks if task.interrupts], "errors": [str(task.error) for task in state.tasks if task.error], "integrated_commit": state.values.get("integrated_commit")}, indent=2)) + '</pre>',
754	             '<h2>Timeline</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps(events, indent=2)) + '</pre>']
755	    positions, edges, width, height = lane_positions(list(runtime.workers))
756	    svg = [f'<h2>Execution graph</h2><svg role="img" aria-label="Workflow execution graph" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">']
757	    for left, right in edges:
758	        x1, y1 = positions[left]; x2, y2 = positions[right]
759	        svg.append(f'<line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" stroke="#9aa"/>')
760	    for name, (x, y) in positions.items():
761	        color = '#665000' if name in state.next else '#263747'
762	        svg.append(f'<rect x="{x-75}" y="{y-23}" width="150" height="46" rx="8" fill="{color}" stroke="#9aa"/><text x="{x}" y="{y+5}" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="14">{html.escape(name)}</text>')
763	    lanes = ", ".join(runtime.workers) + (f" (excluded: {', '.join(runtime.excluded)})" if runtime.excluded else "")
764	    svg.append(f'</svg><p>Lanes: {html.escape(lanes)}. Highlighted nodes are pending. A completed launch is not a completed worker task.</p>')
765	    parts[2:2] = svg
766	    from urllib.parse import quote
767	    for path in packets:
768	        packet = read_json(path)
769	        parts.append('<section><h2>' + html.escape(str(path.relative_to(runtime.directory))) + '</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps({"gate": packet["gate"], "result": packet["result"]}, indent=2)) + '</pre>')
770	        for artifact in packet["result"]["artifacts"]:
771	            local = Path(packet["artifact_paths"][artifact["artifact_id"]]).resolve()
772	            if not local.is_relative_to(runtime.directory):
773	                continue
774	            url = quote(str(local.relative_to(runtime.directory)), safe="/")
775	            parts.append(f'<p><a href="{url}">{html.escape(artifact["artifact_id"])}</a></p>')
776	            if artifact["kind"] == "screenshot":
777	                parts.append(f'<img alt="Browser scenario screenshot" src="{url}">')
778	        parts.append('</section>')
779	    failure_report = runtime.directory / "failure-report.json"
780	    if failure_report.exists():
781	        parts.append('<h2>Checkpoint failure drill</h2><pre>' + html.escape(failure_report.read_text()) + '</pre>')
782	    destination = runtime.directory / "report.html"
783	    destination.write_text("\n".join(parts))
784	    return destination

27	    return node == REVIEW or node.startswith("review-")

30	def pane_label(node: str) -> str:
31	    """`Claude: <lane>`, `Claude: reviewer` for the default reviewer, `Claude: reviewer <id>` for a declared one."""
32	    if node == REVIEW:
33	        return "Claude: reviewer"

39	class InteractiveSessions(ClaudeSessions):
40	    """Native Claude background sessions, not print-mode jobs or Herdr-owned agents."""
41	
42	    def inventory(self) -> list[dict]:
43	        response = subprocess.run([self.executable, "agents", "--json"],
44	                                  capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=15)
45	        rows = json.loads(response.stdout)
46	        if not isinstance(rows, list):
47	            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected Claude inventory response")
48	        return rows
49	
50	    def launch_name(self, node: str) -> str:
51	        """`workflow-<run>-<lane>`, `workflow-<run>-reviewer` for the default reviewer, `workflow-<run>-reviewer-<id>` otherwise."""
52	        if node == REVIEW:
53	            return f"workflow-{self.plan['run_id']}-reviewer"
54	        if node.startswith("review-"):
55	            return f"workflow-{self.plan['run_id']}-reviewer-{node[len('review-'):]}"
56	        return f"workflow-{self.plan['run_id']}-{node}"
57	
58	    def node_worktree(self, node: str) -> Path:
59	        """Workers live in the plan's worktrees; every reviewer in the run's shared candidate checkout."""
60	        if is_review_node(node):
61	            return self.directory / "review-worktree"
62	        return Path(self.plan["nodes"][node]["worktree"])
63	
64	    def locate(self, node: str, rows: list[dict]) -> dict | None:
65	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
66	        if not path.exists():
67	            return None
68	        receipt = read_json(path)
69	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(self.plan):
70	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot reconcile session")
71	        background_id = receipt.get("background_id")
72	        if not background_id:
73	            log = self.directory / f"{node}.launch.log"
74	            if not log.exists():
75	                return None
76	            # --bg assigns its own UUID. Bind the ID printed by this launch;
77	            # never adopt a guessed UUID or a name-only match.
78	            ids = set(re.findall(r"claude attach ([a-f0-9-]{8,36})\s", log.read_text(errors="replace")))
79	            if len(ids) != 1:
80	                raise RuntimeError("Missing/ambiguous native launch ID; reconcile manually")
81	            background_id = ids.pop()
82	        matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("id") == background_id]
83	        if not matches:
84	            return None
85	        if len(matches) != 1:
86	            raise RuntimeError("Ambiguous Claude session identity")
87	        row = matches[0]
88	        if row.get("kind") != "background" or Path(row.get("cwd", "")).resolve() != self.node_worktree(node).resolve() or row.get("name") != self.launch_name(node):
89	            raise RuntimeError("Claude session identity/worktree mismatch")
90	        if receipt.get("background_id") and row.get("sessionId") != receipt.get("session_id"):
91	            raise RuntimeError("Native Claude UUID changed; refusing attachment")
92	        if not isinstance(row.get("sessionId"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9-]{36}", row["sessionId"]):
93	            raise RuntimeError("Missing native Claude UUID")
94	        # `done` is a finished TURN, not a terminated terminal. Require the
95	        # native live PID as well; stale registry rows must not imply restart.
96	        if row.get("state") not in {"idle", "working", "blocked", "done"}:
97	            raise RuntimeError(f"Session is not attachable: {row.get('state')!r}; reconcile manually")
98	        pid = row.get("pid")
99	        if not isinstance(pid, int) or pid <= 0:
100	            raise RuntimeError("No live native PID; reconcile session before attaching")
101	        try:
102	            os.kill(pid, 0)
103	        except OSError as error:
104	            raise RuntimeError("Native process is unavailable; refusing implicit restart") from error
105	        return row
106	
107	    settle_seconds = 30.0
108	
109	    def settle(self, node: str) -> dict:
110	        """Bind the row created by the launch we just issued.
111	
112	        `claude --bg` exits before the native session has fully registered: the
113	        inventory row can appear without a PID for a moment. Poll for the exact
114	        row until it is attachable; identity mismatches still fail immediately
115	        and nothing is ever launched again from here.
116	        """
117	        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.settle_seconds
118	        while True:
119	            try:
120	                row = self.locate(node, self.inventory())
121	            except RuntimeError as error:
122	                if "No live native PID" not in str(error) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
123	                    raise
124	                row = None
125	            if row is not None:
126	                return row
127	            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
128	                raise RuntimeError("No exact matching background session after launch")
129	            time.sleep(1)
130	
131	    def reconcile(self, node: str, path: Path, receipt: dict) -> dict:
132	        """An existing receipt binds the one session this intent produced; nothing is launched again."""
133	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(self.plan):
134	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; refusing session reuse")
135	        row = self.locate(node, self.inventory())
136	        if row is None:
137	            raise RuntimeError("Existing launch cannot be reconciled; no automatic relaunch")
138	        receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
139	        receipt.pop("error", None)
140	        save_json(path, receipt)
141	        return receipt
142	
143	    def launch(self, node: str, path: Path, receipt: dict, command: list[str], cwd: Path) -> dict:
144	        """Run the short `claude --bg` helper once, then bind the exact row it created."""
145	        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("HERDR_")}
146	        try:
147	            # This command creates Claude's own persistent terminal, then exits.
148	            # Killing this short helper is NOT evidence that the session stopped.
149	            with (self.directory / f"{node}.launch.log").open("w") as log:
150	                try:
151	                    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log,
152	                                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)
153	                finally:
154	                    log.flush()
155	                    os.fsync(log.fileno())
156	            if result.returncode != 0:
157	                raise RuntimeError(f"Claude background launch exited {result.returncode}; inspect launch log")
158	            row = self.settle(node)
159	            receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
160	        except BaseException as error:
161	            receipt.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
162	            raise
163	        finally:
164	            save_json(path, receipt)
165	        return receipt
166	
167	    def run(self, node: str) -> dict:
168	        if node not in self.workers or self.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
169	            raise ValueError("Expected an interactive worker plan")
170	        info = self.plan["nodes"][node]
171	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
172	        if path.exists():
173	            return self.reconcile(node, path, read_json(path))
174	        cwd = Path(info["worktree"])
175	        if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"] or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"):
176	            raise RuntimeError("Worktree changed since preparation")
177	        # Native IDs do not exist until launch. Reject conflicting terminal names.
178	        if any(row.get("name") == self.launch_name(node) for row in self.inventory()):
179	            raise RuntimeError("Unowned session already exists with this launch name")
180	        receipt = {"node_id": node, "session_id": None, "launch_token": info["session_id"], "plan_digest": plan_digest(self.plan),
181	                   "worktree": str(cwd), "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"],
182	                   "status": "launching", "attempt": 1, "launcher_invocations": 1,
183	                   "launch_requested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
184	        save_json(path, receipt)
185	        automatic = bool(self.plan.get("automatic"))
186	        if automatic:
187	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
188	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
189	        tools = "Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write" if self.plan["allow_edits"] else "Read,Glob,Grep"
190	        if automatic:
191	            tools += ",Bash"
192	        prompt = worker_prompt(self.directory, self.plan, node)
193	        # The exact prompt is run evidence (the viewer shows it); it is private like the receipts.
194	        write_private(self.directory / f"{node}.prompt.txt", prompt)
195	        command = [self.executable, "--bg", "--name", self.launch_name(node),
196	                   "--safe-mode", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", '{"mcpServers":{}}',
197	                   "--tools", tools, "--permission-mode", "bypassPermissions" if automatic else "manual"]
198	        if automatic:
199	            command.append("--dangerously-skip-permissions")
200	        command.append(prompt)
201	        return self.launch(node, path, receipt, command, cwd)
202	
203	    def run_reviewer(self, reviewer_id: str, prompt: str, launch_token: str, candidate_commit: str) -> dict:
204	        """Launch (or reconcile) one native reviewer session for this candidate.
205	
206	        Every reviewer reads the same candidate checkout and the run directory; its only
207	        permitted write is its own completion file, which the controller later validates.
208	        """
209	        if self.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
210	            raise ValueError("Expected an interactive run plan")
211	        node = review_node(reviewer_id)
212	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
213	        if path.exists():
214	            return self.reconcile(node, path, read_json(path))
215	        cwd = self.node_worktree(node)
216	        if not cwd.is_dir():
217	            raise RuntimeError("Review worktree is missing; the review node creates it before launching a reviewer")
218	        if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != candidate_commit or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"):
219	            raise RuntimeError("Review worktree is not at the clean candidate commit")
220	        if any(row.get("name") == self.launch_name(node) for row in self.inventory()):
221	            raise RuntimeError("Unowned session already exists with this launch name")
222	        receipt = {"node_id": node, "session_id": None, "launch_token": launch_token, "plan_digest": plan_digest(self.plan),
223	                   "worktree": str(cwd), "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"], "candidate_commit": candidate_commit,
224	                   "status": "launching", "attempt": 1, "launcher_invocations": 1,
225	                   "launch_requested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
226	        save_json(path, receipt)
227	        write_private(self.directory / f"{node}.prompt.txt", prompt)
228	        # Claude permission rules spell absolute paths as //absolute/path, and file writes are
229	        # governed by the Edit rule family (Write, Edit, NotebookEdit): under dontAsk a rule
230	        # spelled Write(...) never matches and every write is denied (seen live), while
231	        # Edit(//<path>) allows exactly that file and keeps every other write denied.
232	        completion = str(self.directory / f"{node}.completion.json").lstrip("/")
233	        # --tools, --allowedTools and --add-dir are variadic: any of them directly before the
234	        # positional prompt would swallow it (the session would start idle, without a task).
235	        # The prompt therefore follows --permission-mode, which takes exactly one value.
236	        command = [self.executable, "--bg", "--name", self.launch_name(node),
237	                   "--safe-mode", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", '{"mcpServers":{}}',
238	                   "--tools", "Read,Glob,Grep,Write", "--allowedTools", f"Edit(//{completion})",
239	                   "--add-dir", str(self.directory), "--permission-mode", "dontAsk", prompt]
240	        return self.launch(node, path, receipt, command, cwd)

243	def worker_prompt(directory: Path, plan: dict, node: str) -> str:
244	    """What a native worker session receives: the rules, its pinned task, the run's decisions.md, and in automatic mode the completion protocol."""
245	    prompt = ("You are a workflow worker in your own worktree. A human can type directly into this terminal. "
246	              "Do not launch agents, commit, merge, push or modify shared contracts. Stay within this worktree. "
247	              "Report changed files, checks actually executed, and open assumptions. "
248	              "Completion of a turn is not workflow approval.\n\n" + plan["nodes"][node]["task"] + decisions_block(plan))
249	    if plan.get("automatic"):
250	        from .automatic import completion_prompt
251	        prompt += completion_prompt(directory, plan, node)
252	    return prompt

255	def write_private(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
256	    path.write_text(text)
257	    os.chmod(path, 0o600)
258

260	def require_shell(pane_id: str, settle_seconds: float = 10.0) -> None:
261	    """Only type into a pane whose sole foreground process is its own idle shell.
262	
263	    A pane Herdr just created reports no shell, or a shell still running its
264	    startup files, for a moment. Poll briefly for the idle-shell state; a pane
265	    that is still occupied at the deadline is refused, never typed into.
266	    """
267	    deadline = time.monotonic() + settle_seconds
268	    while True:
269	        process = herdr("pane", "process-info", "--pane", pane_id)["result"]["process_info"]
270	        foreground = process.get("foreground_processes", [])
271	        shell_pid = process.get("shell_pid")
272	        if shell_pid and len(foreground) == 1 and foreground[0].get("pid") == shell_pid:
273	            return
274	        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
275	            raise RuntimeError(f"Pane {pane_id} is occupied; refusing to type an attach command into it")
276	        time.sleep(0.5)
277	
278	
279	def attach_panels(sessions: InteractiveSessions) -> dict:
280	    directory = sessions.directory
281	    mapping_path = directory / "terminals.json"
282	    workers = list(sessions.workers)
283	    reviewers = review_nodes(sessions.plan)
284	    if mapping_path.exists():
285	        mapping = read_json(mapping_path)
286	        if set(workers) <= set(mapping) and any(node not in mapping and (directory / f"{node}.interactive.json").exists() for node in reviewers):
287	            # The workers' tab exists and a reviewer appeared after it: add only the missing reviewer panes.
288	            return attach_reviewer_panel(sessions)
289	        raise RuntimeError("Terminal mappings already exist; use attach-one inside an available terminal to reconnect")
290	    rows = sessions.inventory()
291	    for node in workers:
292	        receipt = read_json(directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")
293	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan) or sessions.locate(node, rows) is None:
294	            raise RuntimeError("Cannot attach an unverified/missing session")
295	    caller = herdr("pane", "current", "--current")["result"]["pane"]
296	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
297	    # The first lane takes the tab's root pane; each following lane splits right of the previous one.
298	    created = herdr("tab", "create", "--workspace", caller["workspace_id"], "--cwd", str(source),
299	                    "--label", f"Workflow: {directory.name}", "--no-focus")["result"]
300	    tab_id = created["tab"]["tab_id"]
301	    mapping = {workers[0]: {"pane_id": created["root_pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": tab_id, "mode": "allocated"}}
302	    save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
303	    for previous, node in zip(workers, workers[1:]):
304	        split = herdr("pane", "split", "--pane", mapping[previous]["pane_id"], "--direction", "right", "--cwd", str(source), "--no-focus")["result"]
305	        mapping[node] = {"pane_id": split["pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": tab_id, "mode": "allocated"}
306	        save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
307	    # Reviewers that already exist (attach after the review node started) get their panes now, in declared
308	    # order; otherwise the review node adds them through attach_reviewer_panel as it launches them.
309	    for node in reviewers:
310	        if (directory / f"{node}.interactive.json").exists() and sessions.locate(node, rows) is not None:
311	            allocate_reviewer_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node)
312	    for node, entry in mapping.items():
313	        attach_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node, sessions.locate(node, rows)["sessionId"])
314	    return mapping
315	
316	
317	def allocate_reviewer_pane(sessions: InteractiveSessions, mapping: dict, mapping_path: Path, node: str = REVIEW) -> None:
318	    """A reviewer pane splits right of the previous pane: the last lane's for the first reviewer, then each reviewer's predecessor."""
319	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
320	    reviewers = review_nodes(sessions.plan)
321	    earlier = [item for item in reviewers[:reviewers.index(node)] if item in mapping] if node in reviewers else []
322	    last = mapping[earlier[-1] if earlier else sessions.workers[-1]]
323	    split = herdr("pane", "split", "--pane", last["pane_id"], "--direction", "right", "--cwd", str(source), "--no-focus")["result"]
324	    mapping[node] = {"pane_id": split["pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": last["tab_id"], "mode": "allocated"}
325	    save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
326	
327	
328	def attach_pane(sessions: InteractiveSessions, mapping: dict, mapping_path: Path, node: str, session_id: str) -> None:
329	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
330	    entry = mapping[node]
331	    require_shell(entry["pane_id"])
332	    herdr("pane", "rename", entry["pane_id"], pane_label(node))
333	    # Re-check identity in the actual attachment process immediately before exec.
334	    command = shlex.join([sys.executable, "-m", "workflow.interactive", "attach-one", str(sessions.directory), "--node", node])
335	    command = f"cd {shlex.quote(str(source))} && {command}"
336	    entry.update(mode="attach_requested", session_id=session_id)
337	    save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
338	    herdr("pane", "run", entry["pane_id"], command)
339	
340	
341	def attach_reviewer_panel(sessions: InteractiveSessions) -> dict:
342	    """Add a `Claude: reviewer <id>` pane beside the workers' panes for every launched reviewer that has none yet, in declared order."""
343	    directory = sessions.directory
344	    mapping_path = directory / "terminals.json"
345	    if not mapping_path.exists():
346	        raise RuntimeError("No terminal mappings; attach the worker panes before the reviewer pane")
347	    mapping = read_json(mapping_path)
348	    if not set(sessions.workers) <= set(mapping):
349	        raise RuntimeError("Terminal mappings lack the worker panes; refusing to add a reviewer pane")
350	    reviewers = review_nodes(sessions.plan)
351	    launched = [node for node in reviewers if (directory / f"{node}.interactive.json").exists()]
352	    if not launched:
353	        raise RuntimeError("No reviewer session receipt; nothing to attach")
354	    missing = [node for node in launched if node not in mapping]
355	    if not missing:
356	        raise RuntimeError(f"Reviewer pane already allocated; use attach-one --node {launched[-1]} inside an available terminal to reconnect")
357	    rows = sessions.inventory()
358	    for node in missing:
359	        if read_json(directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan):
360	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot attach the reviewer")
361	        row = sessions.locate(node, rows)
362	        if row is None:
363	            raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot attach an unverified/missing reviewer session ({node})")
364	        allocate_reviewer_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node)
365	        attach_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node, row["sessionId"])
366	    return mapping
367	
368	
369	def main():
370	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
371	    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["attach-one"])
372	    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)
373	    parser.add_argument("--node", help="attach-one: a worker lane of the run, or a reviewer node (review, or review-<id>)")
374	    args = parser.parse_args()
375	    directory = args.directory.resolve()
376	    try:
377	        sessions = InteractiveSessions(directory, timeout=45)
378	        if sessions.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
379	            parser.error("Not an interactive run; prepare a new run instead of converting print-mode sessions")
380	        if not args.node or not sys.stdin.isatty():
381	            parser.error("attach-one requires --node and an interactive terminal")
382	        if args.node not in sessions.workers and args.node not in review_nodes(sessions.plan):
383	            parser.error(f"--node must be a lane of this run ({', '.join(sessions.workers)}) or {', '.join(review_nodes(sessions.plan))}")
384	        receipt = read_json(directory / f"{args.node}.interactive.json")
385	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan):
386	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot attach")
387	        row = sessions.locate(args.node, sessions.inventory())
388	        if row is None:
389	            raise RuntimeError("Session unavailable; refusing implicit restart")
390	        os.chdir(sessions.node_worktree(args.node))
391	        os.execvp(sessions.executable, [sessions.executable, "attach", row["id"]])
392	    except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
393	        parser.exit(1, f"Blocked: {error}\nSession/worktree state retained at {directory}; no automatic stop or relaunch.\n")
394	
395	
396	if __name__ == "__main__":
397	    main()

80	def placeholders(folder: Path) -> list[str]:
81	    """Every placeholder `init` left in the files it writes, as `<file>:<line>: <text>`.
82	
83	    Only `feature.json`, `policy.json`, `README.md`, `decisions.md` and the task files `feature.json` names are scanned, and only a
84	    JSON string value or a Markdown line that begins with `TODO:` counts. Prose that mentions the marker, reviewer
85	    briefs and any other file are never refused.
86	    """
87	    found = []
88	    tasks = []
89	    try:
90	        manifest = json.loads((folder / "feature.json").read_text())
91	        tasks = [worker["task"] for worker in manifest.get("workers", []) if isinstance(worker, dict) and isinstance(worker.get("task"), str)]
92	    except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
93	        pass  # load_feature reports a missing or malformed feature file.
94	    for name in ["feature.json", "policy.json", "README.md", DECISIONS, *tasks]:
95	        path = folder / name
96	        if not path.is_file() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(folder.resolve()):
97	            continue
98	        try:
99	            lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
100	        except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
101	            continue
102	        json_file = path.suffix == ".json"
103	        for number, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
104	            text = line.strip()
105	            if (f'"{PLACEHOLDER}' in text) if json_file else text.startswith(PLACEHOLDER):
106	                found.append(f"{name}:{number}: {text}")
107	    return found

110	def load_feature(folder: Path) -> dict:
111	    """The feature file as 2.0.0, 2.1.0 or 2.2.0; 1.0.0 files are refused.
112	
113	    2.1.0 adds `reviewers`: one entry per reviewer with its brief, a feature-relative file or `builtin:<id>`.
114	    A file without `reviewers` runs the single built-in reviewer. 2.2.0 turns on the guardrails
115	    (workflow/guardrails.py) and adds the optional `challenge` and `prd`.
116	    """
117	    manifest = read_json(folder / "feature.json")
118	    if isinstance(manifest, dict) and manifest.get("version") == "1.0.0":
119	        raise ValueError(LEGACY_FEATURE_MESSAGE)
120	    validate_schema("feature", manifest)
121	    ids = [worker["node_id"] for worker in manifest["workers"]]
122	    if len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
123	        raise ValueError("feature.json declares a worker lane twice")
124	    for node in ids:
125	        validate_node_id(node)
126	    if not is_guarded(manifest) and ("challenge" in manifest or "prd" in manifest):
127	        raise ValueError("feature.json challenge and prd need version 2.2.0")
128	    reviewers = manifest.get("reviewers")
129	    if reviewers is not None:
130	        if manifest["version"] == "2.0.0":
131	            raise ValueError("feature.json reviewers need version 2.1.0")
132	        reviewer_ids = [item["reviewer_id"] for item in reviewers]
133	        for reviewer_id in reviewer_ids:
134	            validate_reviewer_id(reviewer_id, ids)
135	        if len(set(reviewer_ids)) != len(reviewer_ids):
136	            raise ValueError("feature.json declares a reviewer twice")
137	    return manifest

161	def launch_commands(repo: Path, feature: str, run_id: str, run_root: Path, herdr: bool = True, automatic: bool = False,
162	                    worker_timeout_seconds: int | None = None, review_timeout_seconds: int | None = None,
163	                    reviewer_transport: str | None = None, workers: str | None = None) -> tuple[Path, list[list[str]], list[str]]:
164	    """The exact commands a launch runs against the target `repo`, the run directory and any notes; nothing is executed here."""
165	    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}", run_id):
166	        raise ValueError("run-id must be an opaque identifier, not a path")
167	    repo = repo.resolve()
168	    folder = feature_folder(repo, feature)
169	    left = placeholders(folder)
170	    if left:
171	        raise ValueError(f"features/{feature} still has {len(left)} placeholder(s) to fill in:\n  " + "\n  ".join(left))
172	    manifest = load_feature(folder)
173	    notes: list[str] = []
174	    policy_path = feature_file(folder, manifest["policy"])
175	    policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(policy_path))
176	    declared = policy_workers(policy)
177	    if [worker["node_id"] for worker in manifest["workers"]] != declared:
178	        raise ValueError(f"feature.json workers ({', '.join(worker['node_id'] for worker in manifest['workers'])}) must be the policy's lanes in order ({', '.join(declared)})")
179	    tasks = {}
180	    for worker in manifest["workers"]:
181	        path = feature_file(folder, worker["task"])
182	        if not path.is_file() or not path.read_text().strip():
183	            raise ValueError(f"Task file for lane {worker['node_id']} is missing or empty: {worker['task']}")
184	        tasks[worker["node_id"]] = path
185	    # 2.2.0: outcome briefs, decisions.md and the PRD, all refused here, before any Git action.
186	    refused = refusals(repo, folder, manifest, tasks)
187	    if refused:
188	        raise ValueError(f"features/{feature} does not meet the 2.2.0 guardrails:\n  " + "\n  ".join(refused))
189	    reviewers = {}
190	    for reviewer in manifest.get("reviewers") or []:
191	        path = reviewer_brief(folder, reviewer["prompt"])
192	        if not path.is_file() or not path.read_text().strip():
193	            raise ValueError(f"Brief for reviewer {reviewer['reviewer_id']} is missing or empty: {reviewer['prompt']}")
194	        reviewers[reviewer["reviewer_id"]] = path
195	    # Unknown ids, duplicates and an empty list are refused here, before any Git action.
196	    selected = parse_lane_selection(workers, declared)
197	    run = (run_root / run_id).resolve()
198	    if run == repo or repo in run.parents:
199	        raise ValueError("Run storage must be outside the repository")
200	    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "workflow"]
201	    preflight = [*base, "preflight", str(run), "--repo", str(repo), "--policy", str(policy_path)]
202	    start = [*base, "start", str(run), "--live"]
203	    if herdr:
204	        preflight.append("--herdr")
205	        start.append("--herdr")
206	    branch = f"{manifest['branch_prefix']}/{run_id}"
207	    prepare = [*base, "prepare", str(run), "--repo", str(repo), "--policy", str(policy_path)]
208	    if workers is not None:
209	        prepare.extend(["--workers", ",".join(selected)])
210	    for node in selected:
211	        prepare.extend(["--task", f"{node}={tasks[node]}"])
212	    for reviewer_id, path in reviewers.items():
213	        prepare.extend(["--reviewer", f"{reviewer_id}={path}"])
214	    if is_guarded(manifest):
215	        prepare.extend(["--guardrails", "--decisions", str(folder / DECISIONS)])
216	        if "prd" in manifest:
217	            prepare.extend(["--prd", str(prd_path(repo, manifest["prd"]))])
218	        if manifest.get("challenge") is False:
219	            prepare.append("--no-challenge")
220	    commands = [preflight, ["git", "switch", "-c", branch], prepare, start]
221	    if automatic:
222	        from .automatic import automatic_settings
223	        # Reject bad deadlines or an unknown transport before any command runs.
224	        settings = automatic_settings(worker_timeout_seconds, review_timeout_seconds, reviewer_transport)
225	        commands[0].append("--automatic")
226	        commands[2].extend(["--automatic", "--worker-timeout-seconds", str(settings["worker_timeout_seconds"]),
227	                            "--review-timeout-seconds", str(settings["review_timeout_seconds"]),
228	                            "--reviewer-transport", settings["reviewer_transport"]])
229	        commands.append([*base, "automatic", str(run), "--live"])
230	    elif worker_timeout_seconds is not None or review_timeout_seconds is not None or reviewer_transport is not None:
231	        raise ValueError("Timeouts and the reviewer transport apply to --automatic runs only")
232	    drill = policy.get("failure_drill")
233	    if drill and drill["node_id"] not in selected:
234	        notes.append(f"Failure drill skipped: its lane {drill['node_id']} is not selected (selected: {', '.join(selected)}).")
235	    return run, commands, notes

248	def main(argv=None):
249	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
250	    parser.add_argument("feature", help="A directory under <target>/features/ that holds a feature.json")
251	    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, help="Target Git repository (default: the current directory when it is a Git repository "
252	                                                  "with features/, otherwise this tool's own repository)")
253	    parser.add_argument("--run-id", help="Opaque run identifier (default: <feature>-001)")
254	    parser.add_argument("--run-root", type=Path, help="Run storage outside the target (default: ~/.local/state/md-manager-workflows/<feature> "
255	                                                      "for md-manager, ~/.local/state/agent-workflows/<repo>/<feature> otherwise)")
256	    parser.add_argument("--workers", help="Comma-separated subset of the feature's declared lanes to launch (default: every declared lane)")
257	    parser.add_argument("--live", action="store_true", help="Authorize Claude usage")
258	    parser.add_argument("--automatic", action="store_true", help="Bypass worker permission prompts; run through independent review to a verified feature branch")
259	    parser.add_argument("--worker-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: per-worker deadline from launch to completion signal (default 4h, max 24h)")
260	    parser.add_argument("--review-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: reviewer deadline from its launch to its completion file (default 30m, max 24h)")
261	    parser.add_argument("--reviewer-transport", choices=["native", "print"], help="Automatic mode: native attachable reviewer session (default) or headless claude --print")
262	    parser.add_argument("--no-herdr", action="store_true", help="Explicitly omit terminal attachments")
263	    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Validate feature configuration and print commands and the registry entry only")
264	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
265	    run_id = args.run_id or f"{args.feature}-001"
266	    try:
267	        repo = resolve_target(args.repo, Path.cwd())
268	        feature_folder(repo, args.feature)  # An unknown name is refused with the features found, before anything else.
269	        run_root = args.run_root or default_run_root(repo, args.feature)
270	        run, commands, notes = launch_commands(repo, args.feature, run_id, run_root.resolve(), not args.no_herdr, args.automatic,
271	                                               args.worker_timeout_seconds, args.review_timeout_seconds, args.reviewer_transport, args.workers)
272	        prepare = commands[2]
273	        selected = [prepare[index + 1].split("=", 1)[0] for index, item in enumerate(prepare) if item == "--task"]
274	        reviewers = [prepare[index + 1].split("=", 1)[0] for index, item in enumerate(prepare) if item == "--reviewer"] or ["review"]
275	        registry = registry_path()
276	        # The registered graph is the feature's (every declared lane), not this launch's `--workers` subset.
277	        manifest = load_feature(feature_folder(repo, args.feature))
278	        declared = [worker["node_id"] for worker in manifest["workers"]]
279	        challenge = is_guarded(manifest) and manifest.get("challenge", True) is True
280	        entry = registry_entry(repo, args.feature, run_root.resolve(), declared, challenge=challenge)
281	        # Before 2.2.0 nothing is refused; the launch says so once, beside (not among) its notes.
282	        migration = migration_note(manifest)
283	        if args.dry_run:
284	            print(json.dumps({"repository": str(repo), "run_directory": str(run), "workers": selected, "reviewers": reviewers, "commands": commands,
285	                              "executes": False, "notes": notes, "registry": {"path": str(registry), "entry": entry},
286	                              "guardrails": {"feature_version": manifest["version"], "enforced": migration is None, "challenge": challenge,
287	                                             "migration_note": migration}}, indent=2))
288	            for note in notes + ([migration] if migration else []):
289	                print(f"Note: {note}", file=sys.stderr)
290	            return
291	        if not args.live:
292	            parser.error("Use --live to authorize worker usage, or --dry-run to inspect without running anything")
293	        if run.exists():
294	            raise ValueError(f"Run already exists: {run}. Inspect it with status; do not launch duplicate workers.")
295	        # A malformed registry blocks the launch here, before any Git action; it is never rewritten.
296	        merge_registry(read_registry(registry), entry)
297	        for note in notes + ([migration] if migration else []):
298	            print(f"Note: {note}", file=sys.stderr)
299	        try:
300	            for index, command in enumerate(commands):
301	                subprocess.run(command, cwd=command_cwd(command, repo), check=True)
302	                if index == 2:
303	                    # The run directory exists now: make the run visible in the Projects viewer.
304	                    try:
305	                        print(f"Projects registry {registry}: {register(registry, entry)}", flush=True)
306	                    except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
307	                        print(f"Projects registry {registry} not updated: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
308	                if index == 3 and challenge_paused(run):
309	                    # `start` printed the concerns and the resume commands; nothing else runs until the operator decides.
310	                    print(f"\nLaunch paused at the design challenge; no worker was launched. Run: {run}")
311	                    return
312	        except KeyboardInterrupt:
313	            parser.exit(130, f"Launch interrupted. Nothing was rolled back. If workers were started they are still running;\n"
314	                             f"inspect with: {sys.executable} -m workflow status {run}\n"
315	                             + (f"resume with:  {sys.executable} -m workflow automatic {run} --live\n" if args.automatic else ""))
316	        if args.automatic:
317	            print(f"\nAutomatic run finished. Evidence: {run / 'report.html'}. No main merge or push.")
318	            return
319	        print(f"\nRun: {run}\nWorkers ({', '.join(selected)}) are in their dedicated Herdr tab (unless --no-herdr).")
320	        print("Watch/answer permission prompts. When every worker finishes, return to Pi for handoffs and freeze.")
321	        drill_note = next((note for note in notes if note.startswith("Failure drill skipped")), None)
322	        if drill_note:
323	            print(drill_note)
324	        else:
325	            folder = feature_folder(repo, args.feature)
326	            drill = read_json(feature_file(folder, load_feature(folder)["policy"])).get("failure_drill")
327	            if drill:
328	                print(f"The intentional {drill['node_id']} verification drill will block its first attempt; retry that check explicitly after restarting the controller.")
329	        print(f"Status: {sys.executable} -m workflow status {run}")
330	        print("Review and integration still require separate explicit approval. Nothing is pushed.")
331	    except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
332	        parser.exit(1, f"Launch blocked: {error}\nNo fallback, reset or cleanup was attempted. Inspect any retained branch/run state.\n")
333	    except Exception as error:  # jsonschema ValidationError on the feature file
334	        from jsonschema.exceptions import ValidationError
335	        if not isinstance(error, ValidationError):
336	            raise
337	        parser.exit(1, f"Launch blocked: feature.json is invalid: {error.message}\nNo fallback, reset or cleanup was attempted.\n")

45	def validate_automatic(plan: dict) -> None:
46	    settings = plan.get("automatic")

48	        raise ValueError("Malformed automatic run configuration")
49	    if settings["finish"] != DEFAULTS["finish"] or settings["permission_mode"] != "bypassPermissions":
50	        raise ValueError("Unsupported automatic authority")
51	    for key in TIMEOUT_KEYS:

53	            raise ValueError("Automatic timeouts must be bounded positive seconds (at most 86400)")
54	    if "reviewer_transport" in settings and settings["reviewer_transport"] not in REVIEWER_TRANSPORTS:

102	    """A required evidence text is a non-empty string; an optional one is a string or null."""

106	def read_signal(runtime, node: str) -> dict:
107	    """The worker's completion file, validated against the version the run pinned: 1.0.0 before slice 2, 1.1.0 for 2.2.0 features."""
108	    from .guardrails import COMPLETION_VERSION, completion_version
109	    path = runtime.directory / f"{node}.completion.json"
110	    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > 65536:
111	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid completion file for {node}")
112	    item = read_json(path)
113	    version = completion_version(runtime.plan)
114	    evidence = version == COMPLETION_VERSION
115	    expected = COMPLETION_KEYS | EVIDENCE_KEYS if evidence else COMPLETION_KEYS
116	    if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("version") in {"1.0.0", COMPLETION_VERSION} and item["version"] != version:
117	        raise ValueError(f"Completion version {item['version']} refused: this run is pinned at completion {version}")
118	    if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != expected:
119	        raise ValueError("Malformed completion signal" + (": version 1.1.0 needs untested, falsifying_check, verify_yourself and question" if evidence else ""))
120	    if (item["version"] != version or item["run_id"] != runtime.plan["run_id"] or item["node_id"] != node
121	            or item["launch_token"] != runtime.plan["nodes"][node]["session_id"]):
122	        raise ValueError("Stale or foreign worker completion signal")
123	    statuses = {"completed", "blocked", "question"} if evidence else {"completed", "blocked"}
124	    if item["status"] not in statuses or not isinstance(item["summary"], str) or not item["summary"].strip():
125	        raise ValueError("Invalid completion status/summary")
126	    if not isinstance(item["open_assumptions"], list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in item["open_assumptions"]):
127	        raise ValueError("Invalid completion assumptions")
128	    if evidence:
129	        completed = item["status"] == "completed"
130	        untested = item["untested"]
131	        if not (isinstance(untested, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in untested) or (untested is None and not completed)):
132	            raise ValueError("Invalid completion evidence: untested must be a list of strings")
133	        if not text_or_none(item["falsifying_check"], completed) or not text_or_none(item["verify_yourself"], completed):
134	            raise ValueError("Invalid completion evidence: a completed 1.1.0 completion needs a non-empty falsifying_check and verify_yourself")
135	        if item["status"] == "question" and not text_or_none(item["question"], True):
136	            raise ValueError("Invalid completion: status question needs a non-empty question")
137	        if completed and item["question"] is not None:
138	            raise ValueError("Invalid completion: a completed file has question null")
139	    return item

143	    item = read_signal(runtime, node)
144	    if item["status"] == "blocked":
145	        raise RuntimeError(f"Worker {node} explicitly blocked: {item['summary']}")
146	    if item["status"] == "question":
147	        raise RuntimeError(f"Worker {node} asked a question that is not recorded yet: {item['question']}")
148	    return {"summary": item["summary"], "open_assumptions": item["open_assumptions"]}

156	def wait_handoffs(runtime, *, clock=time.time, sleep=time.sleep) -> None:
157	    """Idle alone never means completion. Deadlines survive controller restart.
158	
159	    A 1.1.0 `question` completion pauses only that lane's deadline (persisted in `<node>.deadline.json`) until the
160	    operator answers, with `workflow answer` or by typing in the pane; the other lanes keep running.
161	    """
162	    from .guardrails import PANE_ANSWER, deadline_extension, load_questions, record_answer, record_question, waiting_question
163	    validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
164	    workers = lanes(runtime)
165	    if any((runtime.directory / f"{node}.stop.json").exists() for node in workers):
166	        # Recover a controller crash after durable handoffs/stop intent, before snapshot.
167	        for node in workers:
168	            if read_completion(runtime, node) != read_json(runtime.directory / f"{node}.handoff.json"):
169	                raise RuntimeError("Handoff changed after stop intent")
170	        return
171	    attention: set[str] = set()
172	    # Answers recorded before this controller started need no second event.
173	    answered = {(node, entry["n"]) for node in workers for entry in load_questions(runtime.directory, node) if entry["answer"] is not None}
174	    while True:
175	        rows = runtime.sessions.inventory()
176	        handoffs = {}
177	        for node in workers:
178	            receipt = read_json(runtime.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")
179	            started = datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["launch_requested_at"]).timestamp()
180	            extension = deadline_extension(runtime.directory, node)  # None while a question waits: that lane has no running deadline.
181	            if extension is not None and clock() >= started + runtime.plan["automatic"]["worker_timeout_seconds"] + extension:
182	                raise RuntimeError(f"Worker {node} deadline exhausted; no automatic relaunch")
183	            row = runtime.sessions.locate(node, rows)
184	            if row is None:
185	                raise RuntimeError("Native worker missing; reconciliation required")
186	            if row["state"] == "working" and waiting_question(runtime.directory, node):
187	                # The operator typed the answer in the pane: the worker is working again, so its deadline runs again.
188	                record_answer(runtime.directory, node, PANE_ANSWER, clock)
189	            for entry in load_questions(runtime.directory, node):
190	                if entry["answer"] is not None and (node, entry["n"]) not in answered:
191	                    answered.add((node, entry["n"]))
192	                    runtime.event(node, "interactive", f"Worker {node} question {entry['n']} answered; its deadline runs again")
193	            if row["state"] == "blocked" and node not in attention:
194	                # A native session reports `blocked` when its turn ended needing a human: a question,
195	                # a permission prompt or a refusal the harness could not continue past. That is not a
196	                # failure of the lane, and the other lanes keep working. The operator may answer in the
197	                # pane; the worker deadline bounds the wait. No billing/provider fallback.
198	                attention.add(node)
199	                runtime.event(node, "interactive", f"Worker {node} needs attention in its pane (native state blocked); "
200	                                                   "waiting until its deadline")
201	            elif row["state"] != "blocked":
202	                attention.discard(node)
203	            path = runtime.directory / f"{node}.completion.json"
204	            if row["state"] in {"idle", "done"} and path.exists():
205	                if read_signal(runtime, node)["status"] == "question":
206	                    record_question(runtime, node, read_signal(runtime, node), clock)
207	                    continue
208	                handoffs[node] = read_completion(runtime, node)
209	        if set(handoffs) == set(workers):
210	            for node, value in handoffs.items():
211	                save_json(runtime.directory / f"{node}.handoff.json", value)
212	            return
213	        sleep(2)

322	class ReviewStatus:
323	    """The combined review status plus one status per reviewer, persisted together.
324	
325	    The default reviewer keeps today's single file: its own keys (launch token, session, decision) are
326	    merged into `automatic-review.json`, whose combined `status` wins. Declared reviewers each get
327	    `automatic-review-<id>.json` beside the combined file.
328	    """
329	
330	    def __init__(self, runtime, combined: dict, statuses: dict):
331	        self.runtime, self.combined, self.statuses = runtime, combined, statuses
332	        # Accepted decisions live here until the combined decision persists them (or a deadline/rejection retains them).
333	        self.decisions: dict = {}
334	
335	    @property
336	    def ids(self) -> list[str]:
337	        return list(self.statuses)
338	
339	    @classmethod
340	    def load(cls, runtime) -> "ReviewStatus":
341	        combined = read_json(combined_status_path(runtime))
342	        ids = combined.get("reviewers") or reviewer_ids(runtime.plan)
343	        statuses = {}
344	        for reviewer_id in ids:
345	            path = reviewer_status_path(runtime, reviewer_id)
346	            statuses[reviewer_id] = read_json(path) if path.exists() else {"reviewer_id": reviewer_id, "node_id": review_node(reviewer_id), "status": "pending"}
347	        return cls(runtime, combined, statuses)
348	
349	    def save(self) -> None:
350	        merged = {}
351	        for reviewer_id, status in self.statuses.items():
352	            path = reviewer_status_path(self.runtime, reviewer_id)
353	            if path == combined_status_path(self.runtime):
354	                merged = status
355	            else:
356	                save_json(path, status)
357	        save_json(combined_status_path(self.runtime), {**merged, **self.combined})
358	
359	    def record_decisions(self) -> None:
360	        for reviewer_id, decision in self.decisions.items():
361	            self.statuses[reviewer_id]["decision"] = decision
362	
363	    def supersede_running(self) -> None:
364	        """A reviewer still working when the run is decided is stopped; its status records why nothing waited for it."""
365	        for status in self.statuses.values():
366	            if status.get("status") in {"pending", "launching", "running"}:
367	                status["status"] = "superseded"
